propositions: BindingRepository must own and persist live, retired, rotation, and alert files with byte-identical sorted/indented/trailing-newline JSON and no eager write on construction
Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, retaining inline last_get_pass floor on rotation failure without raising
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts deduped alert

Live persistence failure leaves live old, retains any earlier successful rotation/retired write, cleans temp, and raises; rotation failure leaves sidecar old and live new with inline floor retained without raising
After rotation persistence failure, the next successful save must write the retained inline floor to the rotation sidecar before live replacement
Alert persistence failure is swallowed and does not alter the successful state-file write result
